mapper.sql: id, supplier_id, supplier_ticket_item_id, session_id, name, description, min_sale_qty, max_sale_qty, price, currency, stock_show_num, plu, plu_id, status, person_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_ticket_item ( supplier_id, supplier_ticket_item_id, session_id, name, description, min_sale_qty, max_sale_qty, price, currency, stock_show_num, plu, plu_id, status, person_count, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{supplierId}, #{supplierTicketItemId}, #{sessionId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{minSaleQty}, #{maxSaleQty}, #{price}, #{currency}, #{stockShowNum}, #{plu}, #{pluId}, #{status}, #{personCount}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE api_ticket_item SET session_id = #{sessionId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, min_sale_qty = #{minSaleQty}, max_sale_qty = #{maxSaleQty}, price = #{price}, currency = #{currency}, stock_show_num = #{stockShowNum}, plu = #{plu}, plu_id = IFNULL(#{pluId}, plu_id), status = #{status}, person_count = #{personCount}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
